617630fbad8aa872.summary: How to read clothing labels before buying: spotting cheap polyester blends, fabric weight (GSM), and natural weave quality. Hook: 'Never buy clothes without checking this one tag: how brands fool you with fake luxury fabrics.'
617630fbad8aa872.notes:
- The fabric composition hierarchy: 100% natural fibers (long-staple cotton, merino wool, linen) vs cheap synthetic blends (polyester, acrylic, nylon).
- Why 80/20 cotton-poly blends pill after 3 washes and trap body odor in warm climates.
- Fabric weight (GSM) decoded: 180-220 GSM for heavy durable tees that drape properly; 280+ GSM for hoodies.
- Weave construction: Oxford vs twill vs poplin and checking seam allowances and double-stitching.
- Actionable shopping checklist for young Indian men upgrading their wardrobe on a budget.
